description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit a veterinary practice’s animal record with the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records it answers to: the reading moment; each animal the animal record identifies with its id, reference, name, species, breed, sex and the moment born; each vaccination the animal record claims with its id, reference, the animal, the vaccine and the moment given; each vaccination record entry with its id, reference, the animal, the vaccine and the moment given; each treatment record entry with its id, reference, the animal, the treatment and the moments treated and the follow-up is due; each later visit or follow-up entry with its id, reference, the animal, the treatment it follows up and the moment seen; each set of identity fields another practice record states for an animal with its id, reference, the record kind, the animal and the name, species, breed, sex and birth moment it states. The signed report gives the animal record and the records behind it, each treatment against an animal the animal record identifies, each claimed vaccination against the vaccination record, each follow-up the treatment record requires against a later entry, and each record’s identity fields against the animal record for the same animal, and counts them, and names divergent animal records: a treatment recorded for an animal the animal record does not identify, a vaccination the animal record claims that the vaccination record does not show, a follow-up the treatment record requires with no later entry behind it, and identity fields that differ across the practice’s records for the same animal; then identity fields naming an animal the animal record does not hold and a follow-up visit naming a treatment the treatment record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No animal record entries, or no vaccination record beside claimed vaccinations, leaves those points unverified. Animals, treatments and visits match by letters and digits, so A-1042 and A 1042 are one animal, vaccines, species, breeds and sexes match by their words with plurals folded, names without case or punctuation, dates by the day, and a follow-up due after the reading moment waits. This reads a practice’s record of each animal in its care, whatever the species: wever_agri-livestock-check reads a farm’s herd record against the farm’s own birth, movement and treatment records, while the animal record check reads the veterinary practice’s own copy, so a herd’s veterinary visits can appear in both. Verdict vet_animal_record_divergent, vet_animal_record_partial, vet_animal_record_unverified or vet_animal_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-animal-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.
